description:
Publish a single image to the Instagram feed.

The image must be a JPEG served from a public HTTPS URL that returns the file directly — no redirects, no authentication, no HTML wrapper. Meta fetches it server-side, so a local path or a signed URL that expires will fail.

For two or more images in one post use instagram_publish_carousel. For video use instagram_publish_reel.

Example: "post this photo with the caption 'new drop'" -> image_url="https://cdn.example.com/a.jpg", caption="new drop"

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

alt_text.description: Accessibility alt text. Supported on image posts only, not reels or stories.

caption.description: Caption text, up to 2200 characters. Hashtags and @mentions work inside the caption. Instagram counts a maximum of 30 hashtags.

collaborators.description: Up to 3 public usernames invited as collaborators

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a JPEG image

is_ai_generated.description: Mark the content as AI-generated. Set it when the image was AI-created.

location_id.description: Facebook Page ID of a location to tag

user_tags.description: People to tag. Images need x and y coordinates; videos and reels take username only. The tagged account must be public.

username.description: Public username to tag, without the @

name: instagram_publish_image
title: Publish Image
